     2→
     3→## Overview
     4→
     5→Add proper focus trapping, focus restoration, and keyboard navigation to all Alpine.js modals
     6→
     7→## Rationale
     8→
     9→Current modals (like the movement modal in stock_list.html) lack focus trapping - users can tab out of the modal while it's open. This is both an accessibility issue (WCAG 2.1 Level A) and a usability problem
